{{Color|LegendaryConsumable}} |contains = 18 }} {{QuoteContainer| {{QuoteBox|A mid-grade consumable crate, for those who need a little more punch!|In-Game Description}} }} ==Description== The '''Mid Grade Consumable Crate''' is a mid-tier consumable crate in the game, purchasable for {{Coins|750}}. It yields eighteen consumables, the {{Color|Common}} rarity consumables are less likely to appear, making higher rarity consumables more likely to appear. This crate gives six consumables when unlocked. As there is no limit on how many consumables you can have, it is possible to get duplicates of them from this crate. ==Methods of Obtaining== #Purchase in the store for {{Coins|750}}. #Daily and Weekly Quests. #Redeeming the [[Codes|code]] "IMCONSUMING". #Day 13 and 20 of [[Login Rewards]], track A and B. #4.28% chance from the [[Spin Wheel]]. #Triumphing a match. #*[[Intermediate Mode|Intermediate]] mode: 2% chance. #*[[Molten Mode|Molten]] mode: 5.833% chance. #*[[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode: 5% chance. #*[[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode: 5% chance. #Completing the ''Harbringer'' achievement. #Completing the ''Scorched Earth'' achievement. #*Gives two '''Mid Grade Consumable Crates'''. #Completing the ''Living Weapon'' achievement. #*Gives three '''Mid Grade Consumable Crates'''. #Completing the ''Undergrad'' achievement. #Completing the ''Scholar'' achievement. #*Gives two '''Mid Grade Consumable Crates'''. #Completing the ''Hype Beast'' achievement. #Completing the ''Collector'' achievement. #*Gives two '''Mid Grade Consumable Crates'''. #Completing the ''Mastermind'' achievement. #*Gives two '''Mid Grade Consumable Crates'''. #[[Playtime Rewards]]' Low Grade Chest. #*Provides a 4% chance of obtainment per chest. #[[Playtime Rewards]]' Mid Grade Chest. #*Provides a 15% chance of obtainment per chest. ==Consumables== {| class="light-table align-center pad-5" style="width:300px; margin:0 auto" !
